items.title: 4. Prove

data.body:
Dependency order matters

The site singleton references default navigation, so navigation must exist first. Pages may reference navigation, shared sections, taxonomy terms, templates, or content items, so those targets must exist before a page or menu that names them can publish.

Fleet propagation is tested, not assumed

CI discovers site directories dynamically. Core changes fan out across the fleet; tenant-only content changes remain scoped. A multisite acceptance proof includes an isolation check against a second tenant’s inventory.
